// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// expressions / annotations / decorators
@derive(Debug, Clone)
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
struct Event {}

@route("/users/:id")
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
function loadUser(id: UserId): Result<User, Error> {
    findUser(id)
}

// expressions / annotations / capture
@capture({ default: "move", logger: "borrow" })
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
const handler = () => logger.info("handled");

@unsafe
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
function readPointer(pointer: *uint8): uint8 {
    read(pointer)
}

@safe
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
function checked(): void {}

// expressions / annotations / taint source and sink
@taint("html")
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
@source("network")
@sink("log")
function tagged(input: string): void {}
